summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Contas em Dia (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass covering auth (register, login, me, delete-cascades-bills, 401 w/o token, 409 duplicate email, short-password 422), bills CRUD with per-user scoping (user B gets 404 on user A's bill), category fallback to 'Outros', PATCH /paid creating next-month recurring bill clamped to month end (Jan 31 -> Feb 28), re-toggle paid NOT duplicating next bill, non-recurring not creating next, backup export/import with replace=true/false. Frontend: register -> login -> empty home -> create bill (BRL mask '15055' -> 'R$ 150,55', category chip 'Energia', recurring switch, save) -> summary-card populated -> summary-open-report navigates to /report (report-category-chart with Energia bar, report-share-card renders) -> report-share-whatsapp opens correct https://wa.me/?text=<encoded msg> URL via window.open -> toggle-paid moves bill to section-paid, home-see-all-paid link navigates to filter tab with filter-status-paid chip -> settings theme dark/light chip works -> privacy navigation works -> delete-account via window.confirm dialog cascades bills and returns to login -> re-login after logout works (JWT persistence via SecureStore). No React Native deprecated packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) found.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend code is clean: UUID ids used instead of ObjectId, _id excluded from projections, async/await consistent, env vars via os.environ (no defaults), Pydantic validation on all endpoints, proper 401/404/409/422 status codes, Argon2 password hashing via pwdlib, JWT with required claims (sub/exp).

Recurring bill duplicate-prevention logic in bills.py set_paid uses find_one with same name+recurring+due_date and 'id != current' which correctly prevents duplicates on re-toggle - verified by test_toggle_paid_creates_next_recurring_once.
Delete /auth/me correctly cascade-deletes user's bills before deleting the user (bills.delete_many then users.delete_one).

Frontend uses testID consistently on interactive elements; summary-card, report, bill-form, settings, filter all well-covered. Section-prefixed toggle testIDs (e.g. 'section-soon-toggle-paid-<id>') match review spec's '*-toggle-paid-*' glob.

Minor cosmetic: Expo web wraps Linking.openURL('https://wa.me/...') into a popup that redirects to api.whatsapp.com and in that intermediate redirect some emoji characters show as replacement chars (%EF%BF%BD) - however the ORIGINAL URL opened via window.open is correct per spec, so this is a WhatsApp-side URL handling quirk, not an app bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of covered flows (register, login, logout, re-login, create bill, BRL mask, category chips, recurring switch, summary-card, report chart, WhatsApp share URL, toggle-paid, see-all-paid -> filter tab, theme dark/light, days-before chips, privacy nav, delete-account)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Tests self-register unique TEST_* users with @contas.app domain and clean up via DELETE /auth/me in fixture teardown. UI test also deletes account at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest is configured with -n 2 --dist loadscope in /app/backend/pytest.ini; EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs (.test, .example, .invalid, .localhost) - use @contas.app for test emails. Server lowercases emails on save so assert against email.lower(). Backend URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Home paid toggle testIDs are 'section-{overdue|soon|future|paid}-toggle-paid-{id}', not 'home-toggle-paid-*'. Report share WhatsApp fires window.open with https://wa.me/?text=... which is interceptable via page.evaluate override of window.open.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA; all requested flows work end-to-end.
